provenance.prompt:
Create a transparent-background pixel-art atlas with exactly FIVE square principal-view cells, in order FRONT, RIGHT, LEFT, REAR, BOTTOM, for the exact Iron Trains railcar metal edge-transition tile in the source/current-view contact. Preserve the square horizontal steel transition slab, dark blue riveted plate material, silver rail-edge strip, and orange-brown bolted edge/support blocks. TOP in the contact is the authoritative XY arrangement and must remain unchanged; four lateral edges and underside are requested.

This is a low horizontal floor/rail transition tile lying flat on the ground. All four elevation views are thin slab-edge cross-sections, never upright copies of the top pattern. FRONT/REAR are end edges viewed horizontally from opposite X ends; show only a shallow dark-blue steel slab thickness with appropriate compact silver rail lip and orange support/bolthead cross-sections from the top layout. RIGHT/LEFT are long side edges viewed horizontally; show a continuous low blue steel edge, a thin silver rail strip where the plan has the central rail, and the correct sequence of small orange-brown support block end faces where the plan has them. Do not turn the orange blocks or rail strip into tall posts; they are low attached supports, not vertical objects.

BOTTOM is viewed directly upward from below: show one full XY footprint underside of the steel transition slab, mostly plain dark steel with subtle seams and a narrow silver perimeter edge. Hide top-facing rails, bolts, orange hardware, and all upward-facing surface details behind the slab. Keep the same square plan orientation and overall footprint as TOP. No broad frontal rail/top motif in any elevation, no raised upright edge, no perspective/isometric, labels, shadows, stray pieces or clipping. Crisp pixel-art clusters, transparent background.
